text_blocks.text: The Smart Village campus encompasses several state-of-art of telecommunications facilities. The campus includes one of the most important fiber optic centers (FOC) in the region. NTI's FOC is utilized for providing different activities such as consultations, training, and applied research for technicians who are working in the construction, operation, and maintenance of fiber optic networks fields.

Fiber Networks Essentials
(Registration closed for this track)
Module Name: Fiber Networks Essentials (72 Hours)

Optical Fiber Network Planning course is designed for Telecom Engineers who are interested or working in optical Fiber networks, It will offer a broad base of knowledge around Optical Fiber components and technologies for different applications like OLAN, Data centers, FTTH Networks.

Trainers will be familiar with:
Types and Standards of the Optical Fiber network components.
Planning and designing of FTTH network, and its components, architectures, deployment and testing.

Target Audience
Communication and Network Engineers.
Those who wish to join the field of fiber network planning.

Module Prerequisites
There is no prerequisite module for this course, but learners are encouraged to have the basic knowledge of fiber communications and components.
